Millions of people open our apps every week to feed themselves and their families; the final 10% is the difference between a transaction and a habit.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a build-and-scale role, not a maintenance one. We are hiring a design leader to own a consumer experience domain within the Consumer mega alliance, raise the quality bar across it, grow a high-performing team, and build the design-technology and AI-native capability that turns ambitious ideas into beautifully executed, shipped products. We need a maker and a leader who leads through the work \u2014 not a strategy-only or people-management-only role.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The level \u2014 Director or Senior Director \u2014 will be set by the candidate\u2019s experience and the final scope of the domain. Drive design excellence through every detail.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Build design-technology capability. &lt;\/strong&gt;Champion and scale our design system (Zest) and modern UI foundations. Close the gap between design and engineering through prototyping, design-to-code workflows, and component quality \u2014 making design and engineering faster together.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Make us AI-native. &lt;\/strong&gt;Treat AI as an active part of how design gets done \u2014 accelerating discovery, generating and validating prototypes, and shortening design-to-delivery. LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails\/safety.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch\/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with the Databricks platform \u2014 or the ability to ramp on it quickly \u2014 including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Mit der Kraft von Kreativit\u00e4t gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft f\u00fcr unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen f\u00fcr grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Das bieten wir dir:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Work-Life-Balance&lt;\/strong&gt;: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem pers\u00f6nlichen Austausch im Office und erg\u00e4nzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. \u00dcberstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Vacation mode on&lt;\/strong&gt;: Du erh\u00e4ltst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag \u2013 zus\u00e4tzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wellbeing first:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Practice makes perfect&lt;\/strong&gt;: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielf\u00e4ltigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme f\u00fcr deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;More than just a job&lt;\/strong&gt;: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Be yourself&lt;\/strong&gt;: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Das bewegst du:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Als &lt;strong&gt;Senior Design Manager (Mensch)&lt;\/strong&gt; bist du Teil unseres 6-k\u00f6pfigen Design-Teams innerhalb der WPP Media Growth-Unit. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg*innen aus New Business, Marketing, Strategie und Responsible Media \u00fcbersetzt du strategische Kernbotschaften in visuell bestechende Geschichten und tr\u00e4gst ma\u00dfgeblich zu erfolgreichen Pitches sowie hochkar\u00e4tigen Vorstandspr\u00e4sentationen bei.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Pitch- &amp;amp; Vorstands-Design:&lt;\/strong&gt; Du entwickelst und gestaltest wirkungsstarke, erstklassige Pr\u00e4sentationen (Schwerpunkt PowerPoint) f\u00fcr nationale und internationale New-Business-Pitches sowie Entscheidungsvorlagen auf GF- und Vorstandsebene.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Motion &amp;amp; Video Content:&lt;\/strong&gt; Du konzipierst und produzierst bewegte Inhalte, Animationen und Video-Assets (z. B. Case-Videos oder dynamische Pitch-Intros) mithilfe von Adobe Premiere und After Effects.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;KI-Integration &amp;amp; Innovation:&lt;\/strong&gt; Du nutzt moderne generative KI-Tools (z. B. f\u00fcr Bild-, Konzept- und Content-Erstellung) eigeninitiativ im Arbeitsalltag, um kreative Prozesse zu bereichern und Workflows zukunftssicher weiterzuentwickeln.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Brand- &amp;amp; Kampagnengestaltung:&lt;\/strong&gt; Du verantwortest die visuelle Umsetzung von Marketingmaterialien und Initiativen \u2013 von digitalen Kampagnen bis hin zu Assets f\u00fcr den Bereich Responsible Media.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Schnittstelle &amp;amp; Sparring:&lt;\/strong&gt; Innerhalb der Growth-Unit arbeitest du eng auf Augenh\u00f6he mit den Fachbereichen (New Business, Strategie, Marketing) zusammen und ber\u00e4tst Stakeholder stilsicher von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Master-Folie.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Das zeichnet dich aus:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Berufserfahrung:&lt;\/strong&gt; Du bringst mehrj\u00e4hrige, fundierte Erfahrung im Pr\u00e4sentations- und Kommunikationsdesign mit \u2013 idealerweise gesammelt im Agenturumfeld oder in einem dynamischen, pitch-getriebenen Setup.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;PowerPoint-Exzellenz:&lt;\/strong&gt; PowerPoint ist dein kreatives Zuhause. Du beherrschst das Tool bis ins Detail und beweist, dass anspruchsvolles Design und PowerPoint Hand in Hand gehen.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Adobe Creative Suite:&lt;\/strong&gt; Du bist absolut versiert im Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud \u2013 insbesondere mit Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign sowie Premiere und After Effects im Bewegtbildbereich.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;KI-Affinit\u00e4t:&lt;\/strong&gt; Du brennst f\u00fcr neue Technologien, experimentierst aktiv mit aktuellen Generative-AI-Tools und verstehst es, diese produktiv und qualit\u00e4tsbewusst in deine Designprozesse zu integrieren.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Fundierte Ausbildung:&lt;\/strong&gt; Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Design \/ Kommunikationsdesign oder eine vergleichbare qualifizierte Ausbildung (z. B. This role is based in our London office with a <strong>hybrid<\/strong> setup, typically 3 days in the office.<\/p>\n<p>Get to know our <a class=\"ng-star-inserted\" href=\"https:\/\/careers.deliveroo.co.uk\/software-engineering-at-deliveroo\/\" target=\"_blank\">Engineering<\/a> team \u2014 what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.<\/p>\n<div style=\"min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;\">&nbsp;<\/div>\n<h2><strong>About the Team<\/strong><\/h2>\n<p>The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.<\/p>\n<p>We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.<\/p>\n<p>&nbsp;<\/p>\n<h2><strong>About the Role<\/strong><\/h2>\n<p>As a BI Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the models, systems and automation behind our BI platforms. This will include supporting our extensive user base on our current BI stack (primarily Looker and Sigma) while helping shape a single, more integrated BI platform across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt.<\/p>\n<p>You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!<\/p>\n<p><strong>You're excited about this opportunity because you will\u2026<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul>\n<li>\n<p>Own and evolve the semantic layer behind our BI platforms: LookML and Canvas BI models, metric and dimension definitions, and the governance that keeps them trusted<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Build and operate the Looker and Sigma platforms themselves: instance and workspace configuration, permissions and user attributes, content lifecycle, and API-driven automation<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Lead the development of self-serve tooling that removes manual BI administration, using usage analytics to decide what to automate, build or retire next<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Support BI platform migrations and deprecations across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt while protecting access, governance, data integrity and business continuity<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Take part in operational support, production debugging and incident response for the BI stack, and fix the root causes you find<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Champion engineering standards in BI, including version control, code review, CI and testing for models and platform code, so changes ship safely and repeatably<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2><strong>We're excited about you because\u2026<\/strong><\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>\n<p>3+ years of experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar code-first data role<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Strong Python and SQL skills, and hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) to accelerate your own engineering work<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Hands-on experience building in a BI platform such as Looker (LookML) or Sigma, modelling and configuring it, not only building dashboards in it<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Experience with semantic or metrics layers (LookML, dbt or similar): defining metrics and dimensions, and keeping those definitions consistent as they are reused<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Experience running what you build in production: version control, code review, CI, debugging live issues and taking part in operational support<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Excellent communication skills, and comfortable self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment with both technical and non-technical teams<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2><strong>Nice to Have<\/strong><\/h2>\n<ul>\n<li>\n<p>Experience with modern data warehousing platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift) and ability to optimize performance<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Experience automating BI administration through platform APIs, or identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li>\n<p>Experience supporting a BI stack across multiple brands, tenants or regions, or leading a BI platform migration<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<h2>Why Join Us?<\/h2>\n<p>At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters\u2014solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:<\/p>\n<p>\ud83d\udd27 <strong>Solve meaningful problems at real scale<\/strong> Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.<\/p>\n<p>\ud83c\udf31 <strong>See your impact, fast<\/strong> Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.<\/p>\n<p>\ud83e\udde0 <strong>Grow through challenge and ownership<\/strong> Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.<\/p>\n<p>\ud83c\udf0e <strong>A culture built for builders<\/strong> High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.<\/p>\n<p>\u27a1\ufe0f Want a deeper look at how we build? reporting and storytelling&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Create executive dashboards, leadership scorecards, PowerPoint presentations, and insight packs that translate data into compelling business narratives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Facilitate action-planning discussions and workshops that help leaders convert employee feedback into meaningful organisational outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as a trusted advisor, providing evidence-based recommendations on employee experience and Qualtrics or similar survey software.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven experience leading or playing a major role in a full Qualtrics implementation from the ground up.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Approximately 5+ years of experience working with employee listening platforms, survey technology, and survey design.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building dashboards, into compelling recommendations for senior stakeholders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience operating within large, complex organisations of 1,000+ employees, ideally in global environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrable experience supporting employee listening programmes across multiple countries.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to analyse data and communicate findings effectively.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;What will make you stand out:&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience supporting global employee populations and large-scale change or transformation programmes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with alternative employee listening platforms such as Medallia, Peakon, Glint, InMoment, or similar technologies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Expertise in employee listening governance, data privacy, survey methodology, and enterprise-scale deployment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive action from insights.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience creating executive dashboards, scorecards, and board-level reporting.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are particularly interested in candidates who have deployed and operated enterprise-scale employee listening programmes rather than those whose Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we\u2019re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: #000000;&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Sony Interactive Entertainment&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Security Architecture | Cloud | AI Security | Enterprise Platforms&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking a Staff Security Architect to help shape and secure the next generation of enterprise, cloud, platform, and AI-enabled technology. This role combines deep security architecture expertise with strong engineering judgment and the ability to influence technical direction across complex, global environments. The successful candidate will partner with engineering, infrastructure, product, and security teams to identify systemic risk, develop scalable security patterns, and guide secure adoption of emerging technologies, including generative AI and agentic systems.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Key Responsibilities&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design, review, and approve security architecture for enterprise, cloud, SaaS, platform, and application environments, balancing business objectives, engineering constraints, and risk.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead cloud security architecture across AWS, Google Cloud, and hybrid environments, including identity, network security, data protection, logging and monitoring, key management, workload isolation, security posture management, and the effective use of native and third-party cloud security controls.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define and review security architecture for SaaS and PaaS platforms, including identity federation, privileged access, tenant configuration, data protection, API and integration security, logging, third-party risk, and secure adoption of enterprise SaaS services.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive security throughout the software delivery lifecycle, including source control, CI\/CD pipelines, build systems, artifact repositories, infrastructure as code, secrets management, code and artifact signing, software provenance, deployment automation, and security controls for developer platforms.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead security architecture for AI-enabled systems, including generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, model-serving platforms, and AI-assisted developer workflows.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design mitigations for risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool use, excessive agency, sensitive-data disclosure, model or supply-chain compromise, unsafe output handling, and abuse of AI services.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define security requirements for AI data, models, prompts, embeddings, vector stores, APIs, tools, and agent identities, including least-privilege access, secrets management, encryption, isolation, provenance, logging, monitoring, and lifecycle controls.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Architect and improve identity, authentication, authorization, network security, key management, cryptography, application security, and production security controls across complex environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify security design gaps in existing and proposed systems; translate findings into practical architecture improvements, reference patterns, hardening standards, preventative controls, and responsible automation that improves repeatability and operational effectiveness.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide technical leadership across multi-disciplinary teams, clearly articulating risks, tradeoffs, and recommended solutions to engineering leaders, business stakeholders, and audiences without a security background.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Required Qualifications&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;15+ years of relevant experience in security architecture, security engineering, product security, cloud security, infrastructure security, or related disciplines, with demonstrated leadership at senior or staff level.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep knowledge of security architecture principles across cloud, application, network, identity, platform, infrastructure, and enterprise environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on experience designing or securing cloud-based and containerized environments, including major cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong understanding of modern identity and access management, PKI, OAuth\/OIDC, SAML, TLS, VPNs, secrets management, key management systems, cloud KMS, and HSMs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Expertise in network and application security controls such as WAFs, NGFWs, segmentation, DMZ design, DDoS mitigation, load balancing, proxies, intrusion detection\/prevention, and host-based controls.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with secure software development, threat modeling, CI\/CD and developer platforms, application security, and engineering mitigations across the software lifecycle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working knowledge of AI\/ML security concepts and the ability to evaluate security risks in generative AI, LLM, and agentic system architectures, including data flows, trust boundaries, model access, and tool integrations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong critical thinking, risk prioritization, communication, and influence skills, with the ability to lead through ambiguity and work effectively across global, cross-functional teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor&#39;s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Preferred Qualifications&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience securing AI\/ML platforms, generative AI applications, model gateways, RAG architectures, vector databases, or agentic workflows in production environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with AI security evaluation, red teaming, adversarial testing, model abuse testing, or control validation for AI-enabled systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience securing large-scale Linux, distributed, multi-tenant, or high-availability production environments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Development or automation experience in Python, C++, Java, or similar languages.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Recognized technical leadership through patents, publications, open-source contributions, conference participation, teaching, or security community involvement.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Penetration testing, adversarial security, or attacker-minded design experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Master&#39;s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Security, or a related field.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p Candidates with the top videos will be selected to move forward with the application process. This is a strategic and tactical role responsible for partnering with internal stakeholders\u2014including People Team, Legal, and executive leadership\u2014to ensure compliance with employment laws, mitigate risk, and support the business in all aspects of employment including advising on employee issues and drafting offer documentation across a complex and diverse regional landscape.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you will do:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide expert counsel on employment law matters across multiple regions. Particular familiarity in Europe, Middle East &amp;amp; Asia including Spain, India, UK, Ireland, Israel, Portugal, Switzerland, Turkey and Germany is required. Support for other regions within the portfolio may also be required.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as a trusted partner to the People Team and business leaders, guiding decision-making on employee relations, risk mitigation, and complex workplace issues.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the Talent and Compensation teams in creation of employment documentation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support employment litigation and dispute resolution in the regions supported, managing outside counsel as needed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide timely, practical, and business-focused legal guidance across multiple jurisdictions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and update region-specific policies, handbooks, contracts, and procedures.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Advise on strategic workforce planning, organizational design, restructuring, and M&amp;amp;A activity.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Advise on works councils, unions and CBAs across the regions.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Monitor and communicate regional legal developments and proactively adjust policies and practices to remain compliant.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What we are looking for:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Law degree with admission to practice in at least one jurisdiction&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Minimum 14 years of progressive experience in global employment law&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven success advising on complex, cross-border employment issues in a global, matrixed environment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capability and a deep understanding of risk management&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent negotiation skills and resilience in partnering with the business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluency in English required; professional proficiency in Spanish would be highly desirable.&amp;nbsp; Additional languages are a plus&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Prior in-house and M&amp;amp;A experience preferred&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in the technology and\/or games industry is a plus&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Please ensure that the r\u00e9sum\u00e9\/CV you attach is written in English.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;About Scopely&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world\u2019s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time \u201cMONOPOLY GO!\u201d and \u201cPok\u00e9mon GO,\u201d along with \u201cStumble Guys,\u201d \u201cStar Trek\u2122 Fleet Command,\u201d \u201cMARVEL Strike Force,\u201d \u201cWWE Champions,\u201d the Scrabble\u00ae franchise, \u201cYahtzee\u00ae With Buddies,\u201d and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry \u2014 bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team \u2014 including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely\u2019s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We contribute to &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/github.com\/monzo&quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;open source software&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/a&gt; as much as possible. As a backend engineer you\u2019ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more!&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Together you&#39;ll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security &amp;amp; Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;They\u2019re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need!&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we\u2019d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You should apply if:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;you\u2019re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;you\u2019re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;you think you\u2019d enjoy the kind of work we\u2019re doing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re on the look out for L30+ Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/monzo.com\/documents\/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf&quot;&gt;Engineering Progression Framework&lt;\/a&gt; you will be interviewed across the whole framework, so if you&#39;re not sure what level you&#39;re aiming for chat to your recruiter!&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Not ticking every box? Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Moniepoint, data is at the core of everything we do. We are a customer-centric company, and your work will enable our teams to make informed, data-driven decisions that directly impact the success of our business. We are seeking a data-driven, impact-oriented Senior Data Scientist to power Moniepoint\u2019s consumer lending decisions at scale. You will build the models, experiments, and insights that shape how we acquire, underwrite, and retain millions of customers across Nigeria and Africa.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This role is pivotal in driving our pricing, credit limit modelling, and credit model deployment strategy in a growing business with unparalleled opportunities to give access to millions of customers.&amp;nbsp;You\u2019ll collaborate with our amazing Consumer Credit team and drive how we think about risk ranking, product offering, and data infrastructure to create the best personalised offers for our customers. You\u2019ll be responsible for building our first suite of credit risk models and help drive a culture of how we should think about machine learning vs more traditional methods - bringing fresh thinking to inspire both the team and our customers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Sitting at the intersection of data science, credit risk, and product, you\u2019ll translate complex data into actionable decisions that drive growth with healthy portfolio performance.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/moniepoint.com\/blog&quot;&gt;Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You\u2019ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop and deploy credit scoring, affordability, and behavioural models to support underwriting, pricing, and collections&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design and run experiments to optimise approval rates, loss rates, and profitability&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with product squads to embed decision logic into real-time systems&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure data quality, compliance, and ethical use of models across all decisioning processes&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mentor product squads on best practices in experimentation and data-driven decision-making&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide models to optimise outcomes in collections, churn management and user retention&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;We would love to hear from you if\u2026&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You\u2019re comfortable with Statistics and have a Degree or qualifications&amp;nbsp; in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or similar)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have +5 years of experience in data science, decision science, or risk analytics within financial services&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working knowledge of credit risk, consumer lending, and regulatory considerations&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficiency in SQL and at least one modelling\/programming language (Python, R)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with A\/B testing, machine learning, collections modelling and churn management&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for business stakeholders&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;High ownership mindset and comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What we can offer you&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Culture: We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We\u2019ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Compensation: You\u2019ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, monthly bonuses, plus other benefits&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What to expect in the hiring process&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A preliminary phone call with the recruiter&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A coding exercise on HackerRank - covering core data science theory (math, statistics, linear algebra) and Python fundamentals (data structures &amp;amp; algorithms).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A take-home assignment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A technical interview with a Lead in our Data Science Team to review your take-home assignment in depth&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A behavioural and technical interview with the hiring manager&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why United Kingdom&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The UK is home to our headquarters where more than 70 team members are based. Our London office is located at Sea Containers, just by London Bridge - this is also where a significant number of our most senior leaders sit, which makes it a natural base for a Head of Engineering.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Rewards to join us in United Kingdom.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About The Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform \u2014 and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there \u2014 the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer&#39;s hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A\/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering \u2014 not a purely backend platform leader.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one \u2014 engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A\/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain \u2014 incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who You Are&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A\/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;At least 5 years of experience managing managers \u2014 leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfort with our backend environment \u2014 Java and Spring Boot \u2014 and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders \u2014 growth, marketing and sales \u2014 and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Cultural Alignment&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What Success Looks Like In The Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The existing cashback product performing measurably better \u2014 faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why Join Us&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A rare blank page. Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We hope that&#39;s you.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h1&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Impact&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;Most of our UK investment to date has gone into winning patients. This role owns what happens next \u2014 whether they stay, whether they grow, and whether the revenue they generate is actually profitable. You will own &lt;strong&gt;Repeat Contribution Margin&lt;\/strong&gt; for the UK: repeat revenue minus the variable cost to serve it, across Hims and Hers in weight-loss, hair, sexual health and TRT. It is a single number and it is yours. You&#39;ll report to the Managing Director, UK and sit alongside the two brand Directors of Growth, who own new patient acquisition.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own UK Repeat Contribution Margin&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 both halves: repeat revenue &lt;em&gt;and&lt;\/em&gt; the variable cost to serve, including retention-linked COGS. Commercial sets the P&amp;amp;L target and owns the model and guardrails; you choose the levers within it, build the plan, and land the number.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Run the monetisation portfolio&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 expansion levers (cross-sell across conditions, service packages and premium tiers, Shop and physical add-ons, paid diagnostics for existing patients) and margin-protection levers (upsell to commit-and-save plans, titration and maintenance plans, cancellation saves, reactivation, loyalty). Decide where to invest, size the prize, and kill what isn&#39;t working.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own churn and save economics&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 cancellation saves, reactivation and win-back. Churn modelling and automated save offers are already in flight; your job is to turn that into a governed P&amp;amp;L lever and to prove incrementality rather than bank credit for patients who&#39;d have returned anyway.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Own the whole post-purchase journey&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 from activation through to lifetime. Where Proposition defines and builds a new offer for a core category, operational execution post-purchase hands off to you.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Lead a condition-level retention team of four&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 a Head of Retention for weight-loss across both brands (with a Strategy &amp;amp; Ops Lead beneath them), plus S&amp;amp;O Leads for Hair\/Sex and for TRT, the latter including activation ops from blood test to first order. Build the bench and raise the bar.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Direct the central and shared functions without managing them&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 you decide and brief; CRM, Patient Support, Clinical Ops, Clinical Outcomes and Product build. You set the experience standard, approve the SLA and cost line, and hold each function to its impact. You will not set clinical protocol, and you will need to be effective without line authority.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Surface, prioritise and win the product roadmap&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 turn retention friction into a prioritised requirement list with a business case, and pitch it to the MD against acquisition work that is easier to justify.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What good looks like.&lt;\/strong&gt; A first six months that delivers a Repeat Contribution Margin baseline everyone trusts, condition-level cost attribution phased in behind it, two or three monetisation levers live with clean reads, and a save programme that survives an incrementality test.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;About you&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Skills &amp;amp; experience&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You have 10-12 years of experience across D2C brands &lt;\/strong&gt;running P&amp;amp;Ls and owning commercial targets.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ve owned a repeat-revenue or contribution-margin number in a subscription or repeat-purchase consumer business&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 not influenced it, owned it. You can talk through the plan you set, what you got wrong, and what you&#39;d do differently.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ve built a monetisation portfolio, not just run retention campaigns.&lt;\/strong&gt; Pricing and packaging, upsell and cross-sell, plan structures, loyalty \u2014 you&#39;ve decided what to build, sized it, and killed the ones that didn&#39;t earn their place.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You are commercially and analytically rigorous on the cost side.&lt;\/strong&gt; You understand contribution margin properly, you&#39;ve worked with imperfect cost attribution and made decisions anyway, and you hold a hard line on incrementality \u2014 including when a flattering headline number is on offer.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ve delivered through functions you don&#39;t manage.&lt;\/strong&gt; CRM, support, ops, clinical, product. You know how to set a standard, agree an SLA, and hold people to impact using influence and evidence rather than reporting lines.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You&#39;ve led and built a small senior team&lt;\/strong&gt; \u2014 hired well, levelled honestly, and given people real ownership of sub-numbers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You operate at pace in ambiguity and bring your own point of view.&lt;\/strong&gt; This role has no playbook at Euc. You&#39;ll be expected to anchor the direction rather than wait for the MD or Commercial to set the agenda.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;Nice to haves&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Healthcare, or another regulated, trust-based consumer category where what you can say and offer is genuinely constrained.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience across more than one market \u2014 Germany mirrors this model as it matures, and weight-loss retention may become EMEA-wide.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;For more information, visit &lt;a href=&quot;wppmedia.com&quot;&gt;wppmedia.com&lt;\/a&gt;.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;3834 - Associate Director, Social, UK&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Role Summary and Impact&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;Associate Director, Social&lt;\/strong&gt; is a senior leader responsible for the strategic oversight, operational excellence, and overall success of a large group within the campaign delivery function. This role leads a team of Senior Campaign Managers, Campaign Managers, and Executives, setting the standard for executional quality, profitability, and innovation. The Campaign Director is accountable for ensuring their entire group&#39;s campaign portfolio is delivered to the highest standard, driving client satisfaction and retention through flawless execution and strategic leadership.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Departmental Leadership &amp;amp; Operational Excellence&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead, mentor, and develop a &quot;group&quot; within the campaign team, including Senior Campaign Managers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Take ultimate responsibility for the successful delivery of all campaigns within your group, having visibility over progress without being involved in the day-to-day running.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Organise and delegate work effectively within your group, ensuring efficient campaign execution and accurate workload monitoring.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Champion and enforce all Goat standards and processes, ensuring your team operates with efficiency and accuracy, and that target margins are consistently met.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Consistently develop and implement new processes to improve campaign performance and team efficiencies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strategic &amp;amp; Commercial Oversight&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Take responsibility for client retention and growth within your group, proactively looking for optimisations and opportunities for the account team to upsell.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the senior sign-off for deliverables (up to \u00a3500k) and complex influencer contracts (above \u00a320,000) within your group, ensuring they are commercially sound and strategically aligned.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Think about all campaigns from a business perspective, with revenue and profitability always in mind.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide senior executional leadership in high-value proposals and pitches, confidently presenting campaign processes and demonstrating expert knowledge of a client&#39;s objectives.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Team Management &amp;amp; Development&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Successfully manage the performance and career progression of your direct reports and wider group, tracking individual progress and providing solutions for underperformance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Identify and nurture future leaders within your group, highlighting successes and promoting a positive team morale.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure all members of your team have measurable, challenging, and achievable targets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead training initiatives, spotting knowledge gaps and working with other Directors to ensure a consistent and engaging training programme for the global campaign team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Quality Assurance &amp;amp; Senior Escalation&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the senior point of escalation for all major executional challenges, able to jump into any campaign to troubleshoot problems and provide solutions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Be responsible for troubleshooting any major content quality issues before they are escalated to a Senior Director.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as the final sign-off on Post-Campaign Analyses (PCAs) for key clients, ensuring they are insightful, accurate, and tailored to the client&#39;s priorities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure your team is consistently using all internal platforms (e.g., CreatorIQ) correctly and to their full potential.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Performance Requirements&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The successful, profitable, and high-quality delivery of the entire campaign portfolio within your group.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A demonstrable contribution to key client retention and growth through proactive strategic optimisations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The successful leadership, development, and high morale of your campaign group.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The successful implementation of new processes that drive efficiency and performance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Positive feedback from senior internal and external stakeholders on the leadership and operational excellence of your group.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Life at WPP Media &amp;amp; Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied accounts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases \u2014 from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering \u2014 channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA\/SE organisation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader \u2014 conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We&#39;re Looking For&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails\/safety.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch\/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with the Databricks platform \u2014 or the ability to ramp on it quickly \u2014 including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A track record of technical leadership and mentorship \u2014 someone who elevates the people around them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data\/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Nice to Have&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML\/GenAI space.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare\/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Why This Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have \u2014 companies building the future in real time \u2014 with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation\u2014including the ethical &amp;amp; thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;134233117&amp;quot;:true,&amp;quot;134233118&amp;quot;:true,&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;What You&#39;ll Do&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As Associate Director, Medical Advisor, EU West, you will report to the Medical Director EU West and provide scientific leadership for three rare-disease launch programs in achondroplasia, limb-girdle muscular dystrophy, and genetic hypocalcaemia. You will translate global strategy into a focused country medical plan, build trusted partnerships across the French rare-disease ecosystem, and ensure high-quality, compliant execution in an agile affiliate environment. The main focus will be France.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Medical strategy and execution:&lt;\/strong&gt; Co-develop and execute the France Medical Affairs plan for the three portfolio programs, with clear priorities, milestones, KPIs, resource needs, and budget assumptions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Scientific leadership:&lt;\/strong&gt; Maintain deep expertise in the diseases, patient journeys, standards of care, competitive environment, and emerging evidence; translate complex data into accurate and relevant scientific narratives for French stakeholders&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;External engagement:&lt;\/strong&gt; Build and sustain peer-to-peer relationships with key experts, multidisciplinary care teams, scientific societies, rare-disease networks, and patient organizations while preserving the independence and integrity of scientific exchange&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Expert and center mapping:&lt;\/strong&gt; Identify and segment relevant centers and stakeholders, characterize referral and treatment pathways, and help quantify patient populations and unmet medical needs across France&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Medical insights:&lt;\/strong&gt; Capture, document, analyze, and communicate actionable field insights to the local and global organization, and close the loop by showing how validated insights inform strategy and execution&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Scientific exchange and education:&lt;\/strong&gt; Deliver balanced, non-promotional scientific exchange; lead advisory boards, expert meetings, congress activities, internal training, and other medical education initiatives&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Evidence generation:&lt;\/strong&gt; Contribute to the local evidence plan, including real-world evidence, registries, epidemiology, outcomes research, collaborative studies, and investigator-sponsored research; support protocol and publication review as appropriate&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Launch and access readiness:&lt;\/strong&gt; Support pre-launch and launch activities by clarifying unmet need, patient identification and referral pathways, multidisciplinary care requirements, and evidence gaps; contribute medical input to early or compassionate access activities when applicable&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Medical review:&lt;\/strong&gt; Provide robust medical review of scientific, educational, market access, and promotional materials through the appropriate review process, ensuring scientific accuracy, fair balance, and consistency with approved information and company standards&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Cross-functional partnership:&lt;\/strong&gt; Work closely with Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Patient Advocacy, Pharmacovigilance, Compliance, and global or regional Medical Affairs while maintaining the appropriate separation between medical and promotional activities&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Safety and quality:&lt;\/strong&gt; Identify and report adverse events, product complaints, and other safety information within required timelines; maintain complete documentation and complete all required training&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Where You&#39;ll healthcare degree&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;At least 3-5 years of Medical Affairs experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including meaningful experience in More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&amp;nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI&quot;&gt;Co-create the future with us&lt;\/a&gt; as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;*&lt;em&gt;Fortune 500\u00ae is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h2&gt;An overview of this role&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As the Director of Regional Sales for France, you&#39;ll take ownership of building and leading our Italian sales presence. You&#39;ll drive revenue growth, implement disciplined sales processes and technology, and partner across account management, customer success, marketing, product, engineering, and operations to deliver exceptional customer experiences. You&#39;ll report to the VP of Sales and balance hands-on field leadership with strategic vision. You&#39;ll stay close to key accounts, develop your sales team, and expand our client base. In this role, you&#39;ll be passionate about open source software, drive repeatable sales processes, and influence GitLab&#39;s growth by establishing disciplined go-to-market strategies, developing sales talent, and executing against ambitious bookings targets in France.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What you\u2019ll do&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;1&quot;&gt;Lead the growth of GitLab&#39;s business in France, taking ownership for building the country plan, pipeline discipline, and day-to-day execution to achieve or exceed quarterly bookings and ARR growth targets.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;2&quot;&gt;Manage, coach, and develop a small team of Account Executives, staying close to the field, joining customer meetings, and modeling hands-on, high-activity sales behaviour.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;3&quot;&gt;Drive new logo acquisition across a broad base of medium-sized Italian businesses while shaping a long-term strategy to engage larger accounts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;4&quot;&gt;Build GitLab\u2019s reputation in the Italian market by partnering with marketing, business development, and local networks to generate pipeline and increase market awareness.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;5&quot;&gt;Establish clear operating rhythms, sales processes, and methodologies that bring structure, organization, and accountability to the team without losing agility.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;6&quot;&gt;Collaborate with regional sales leaders and cross-functional partners across account management, customer success, marketing, product, engineering, and operations to align territory coverage, share best practices, and ensure consistent execution across the region.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;7&quot;&gt;Develop and maintain strong relationships with key accounts at the executive level (CXO and program level), positioning GitLab as a strategic partner and identifying expansion opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;8&quot;&gt;Analyze pipeline, forecast, and performance data to identify gaps and opportunities, adjust plans so the team focuses on the highest-impact activities, and represent the Italian business internally by sharing insights on market trends, customer needs, and resource requirements to inform regional strategy.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What you\u2019ll bring&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;1&quot;&gt;Experience building and leading high-performing sales teams, ideally within France, with a focus on coaching and developing talent.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;2&quot;&gt;Ability to design and execute a country go-to-market plan, including pipeline generation discipline, territory coverage, and disciplined deal execution.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;3&quot;&gt;Strength in balancing hands-on field work with strategic leadership, staying close to customers while managing day-to-day operations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;4&quot;&gt;Familiarity with B2B software or technology sales and open source\/DevSecOps concepts, with enthusiasm for learning GitLab\u2019s platform and building long-term market presence.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;5&quot;&gt;Skills in creating structure, setting clear expectations, and driving organized, data-informed sales processes, including use of MEDDPICC or similar methodologies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;6&quot;&gt;Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to create trust and empathy with both customers and GitLab team members at all levels.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li value=&quot;7&quot;&gt;Comfort operating in a dynamic, growth-focused, all-remote environment, acting as a self-directed \u201cmanager of one\u201d and using Salesforce.com or similar CRM and marketing automation systems to build trackable, repeatable sales processes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;About the team&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll join a regional sales organization focused on growing GitLab\u2019s presence across France, working closely with Account Executives and cross-functional partners in account management, customer success, marketing, product, engineering, and operations. The team is all-remote and collaborates asynchronously across time zones to build pipeline, manage complex sales cycles, and deliver consistent customer experiences. You\u2019ll help shape how we organize coverage, implement disciplined sales processes, and bring structure to a high-growth region while staying aligned with global sales strategy and GitLab\u2019s values of transparency, collaboration, and results.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(255, 255, 255);&quot;&gt;#LI-BC2&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/about.gitlab.com\/handbook\/total-rewards\/benefits\/general-and-entity-benefits\/&quot;&gt;Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/handbook.gitlab.com\/handbook\/people-group\/time-off-and-absence\/time-off-types\/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto&quot;&gt;Flexible Paid Time Off&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/handbook.gitlab.com\/handbook\/company\/culture\/inclusion\/tmrg-tmag\/&quot;&gt;Team Member Resource Groups&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/handbook.gitlab.com\/handbook\/total-rewards\/stock-options\/&quot;&gt;Equity Compensation &amp;amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/handbook.gitlab.com\/handbook\/people-group\/learning-and-development\/growth-and-development\/&quot;&gt;Growth and Development Fund&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/about.gitlab.com\/handbook\/total-rewards\/benefits\/general-and-entity-benefits\/#parental-leave&quot;&gt;Parental Leave&lt;\/a&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/about.gitlab.com\/company\/culture\/inclusion\/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups&quot;&gt;underrepresented groups&lt;\/a&gt; are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you&#39;re excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;hr&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Country Hiring Guidelines: &lt;\/strong&gt;GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Privacy Policy: &lt;\/strong&gt;Please review our &lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/handbook.gitlab.com\/handbook\/hiring\/candidate-faq\/recruitment-privacy-policy\/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Recruitment Privacy Policy.&lt;\/a&gt; Your privacy is important to us.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab\u2019s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That&#39;s the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer&#39;s p99 and on our P&amp;amp;L. Your mandate is the inference stack&#39;s optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The problem:&lt;\/strong&gt; the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the &quot;right&quot; serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don&#39;t: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we&#39;re nowhere near done. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;unrealized throughput lives here, and you&#39;ll own it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;taking an hour to reach serving.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Quantize without regressing quality. INT8\/INT4, FP8\/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill\/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don&#39;t bottleneck&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;on storage or interconnect.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set the technical direction.
