This role requires effective collaboration with Medical Directors, cross-functional colleagues and external experts to ensure scientifically rigorous, consistent and compliant communications and practices. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in scientific\/medical communications with strong project management experience and stakeholder management skills, and thrives on delivering priorities in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the development of scientific communication plans from an international perspective (i.e., core scientific narratives, key messages and Q&amp;amp;A documents), in close collaboration with Medical Directors and cross-functional brand teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop high-quality scientific and medical education content for congresses, symposia, advisory boards, internal training and other settings, ensuring alignment with the medical strategy&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Legal, Regulatory and Medical reviewers to ensure all scientific and medical communications are accurate, balanced and compliant, in line with the Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR) review process&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the design and delivery of onboarding, training and continuous learning programs for Medical Affairs, including building scientific and therapeutic area capability across the organization&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage relationships with medical communications agencies, medical writers and other vendors to ensure high-quality, on-time, on-budget deliverables&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the review, evaluation and compliant administration of independent medical education grants, scientific sponsorships and related third-party contracting, partnering with Legal, Compliance and Finance to ensure appropriate governance and documentation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to the development of standards, processes, tools and best practices that elevate medical excellence across areas such as Field Medical, insights generation &amp;amp; analysis, key performance indicators, training and other Medical Affairs priorities as business needs evolve&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Where You\u2019ll Work&amp;nbsp; &lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;This is an office role and requires in-office collaboration 2-3 days per week in our Zug office&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;No relocation is offered&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Travel (approximately 10-20%) may be required to support scientific congresses, advisory boards, training sessions and internal meetings&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Who You Are&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor&#39;s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, or a related scientific discipline is required; an advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or MSc) is strongly preferred&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;7+ years of Medical Affairs experience in the biotech\/pharmaceutical industry, in one or more of the following areas: scientific\/medical communications, field medical, medical training, or related medical excellence functions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong scientific writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical and scientific data into clear, accurate, audience-appropriate materials&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated experience developing scientific platforms, key messages, and training or capability-building programs in partnership with cross-functional medical and clinical teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience managing external vendors\/agencies and navigating MLR review processes; familiarity with grants, sponsorships, or contracting processes is an advantage&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Versatile and adaptable, able to shift between medical excellence priorities as business needs evolve&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills; experience in rare disease is an advantage&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluent in English; additional language skills are an advantage&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We have high expectations for our team members. You report to the Executive Director, IT Enterprise Applications in the US, and partner closely with International business leaders and US-based IT counterparts.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own the International application and technology roadmap and business relationship, for Commercial and Medical Affairs systems including Veeva CRM, Databricks, and Analytics, while ensuring alignment with enterprise owned platforms managed by US teams. You will direct and technically oversee the consultants and partners who execute this work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the primary strategic IT partner to International business We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h3>The Role<\/h3><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We are seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. In this role, you will lead the physical product design of hardware assemblies, mechanical housings, custom structures, and precision mechanisms, guiding products through CAD design, drafting, prototype verification, and industrialisation.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">From day one, you will own the transition of concepts into production-ready physical hardware. You will maintain strict product data management standards, apply geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, run thermal and stress analyses, work with suppliers across various manufacturing processes, and perform hands-on prototype assembly and testing.<\/p><h3>What You Will Do<\/h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>CAD Design &amp; Drafting:<\/strong> Create clean, fully constrained CAD models, multi-part assembly layouts, and detailed engineering drawings following formal geometric dimensioning and tolerancing standards.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Product Data &amp; Configuration Management:<\/strong> Manage engineering change requests, update bill of materials data, maintain material libraries, and enforce configuration controls in digital product data systems.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Prototype Assembly &amp; Verification:<\/strong> Build physical prototypes, test assembly sequences, verify fit and tolerance stack-ups, and establish unit build procedures.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Environmental &amp; Stress Analysis:<\/strong> Perform structural, thermal, vibration, and mechanical shock simulations to ensure hardware survives harsh operational environments.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Manufacturing &amp; Supplier Integration:<\/strong> Work closely with suppliers to optimize designs for production methods such as CNC machining, stamping, pressing, forging, casting, and injection molding.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cross-Functional Interface Management:<\/strong> Collaborate with electronics, simulation, testing, and systems engineering teams to define physical interface control documents, packaging requirements, and technical datasheets.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><h3>What We Are Looking For<\/h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Background:<\/strong> Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>CAD &amp; We launch new banks, transform existing ones, and help our clients navigate complex change. As consultants, we work on the front-end business design all the way through to technology implementation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are the largest Financial Services focused consultancy in the world, serving everyone from global banks to emerging FinTechs, from strategy through digital transformation, design, business consulting, data and analytics, cyber, cloud, technology architecture, and engineering.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Capco is a young and growing firm. We maintain an entrepreneurial spirit and growth mindset, and have minimal bureaucracy. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Customers and users across the globe use Planet&#39;s data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world\u2019s toughest obstacles.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Role:&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Planet is expanding its platform capabilities to support customers who require dedicated, in-region, or on-premises instantiations of our core platform. As the Senior Product Manager for Sovereign &amp;amp; Hybrid Deployments, you will drive the productization of our platform for isolated, air-gapped, and hybrid environments.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will serve as the critical bridge between high-touch enterprise customer delivery and scalable core engineering. In this role, you will balance deep customer empathy with product discipline\u2014translating complex operational requirements into repeatable core platform capabilities while establishing clear extension points for Professional Services.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin, Haarlem or Ljubljana office 3 days per week.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Impact You\u2019ll Own:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Conduct deep-dive discovery with high-security enterprise and government stakeholders to understand their operational realities, using those insights to set clear, defensible product priorities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define and structure the explicit, phased customer journey framework\u2014establishing the operational models, readiness criteria, and governance standards for initial platform installation, joint-operations training, and the final transition into fully autonomous, customer-operated environments with zero or limited vendor access.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Translate customer operational and security requirements into clear technical specifications for Core Infrastructure and Engineering teams with detail-oriented accuracy. Synthesizes underlying commonalities across clients who describe similar operational needs using different language, preventing costly, redundant engineering effort.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define standardized building blocks that allow the core platform to extend safely into varying edge and air-gapped environments without hardcoding custom variants for every deployment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define clear boundaries for what belongs in the core platform versus what can be customized. Design clear hooks and interfaces so Professional Services and integration partners can build custom extensions without modifying core platform code.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You Bring:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;6+ years of relevant work experience in Technical Product Management focusing on enterprise platforms, hybrid cloud deployments, or complex infrastructure products.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to sit down with enterprise or government clients, listen to complex operational workflows, and identify the root problem behind divergent customer terminology.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Track record productizing cloud-native software platforms to deploy into customer-managed infrastructure, enterprise VPCs, or air-gapped data centers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ability to apply conceptual understanding of enterprise hybrid patterns similar to AWS Outposts, Azure Stack, Kubernetes-based enterprise distribution platforms (e.g., Red Hat OpenShift), or infrastructure automation frameworks (e.g., HashiCorp Terraform\/Vault).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience setting clear boundaries between core platform roadmap items and custom extensions delivered by Professional Services.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Detail-oriented mindset capable of mapping out complex operational transitions, training milestones, and access handoffs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What Makes You Stand Out:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Prior experience navigating European sovereign cloud frameworks, regional data residency mandates, or EU defense\/government compliance standards.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Application Deadline:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;11:45p \/ 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Kimchi Inference&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;One API line and a customer&#39;s existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer&#39;s own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you&#39;ll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em data-prosemirror-content-type=&quot;mark&quot; data-prosemirror-mark-name=&quot;em&quot;&gt;&lt;span id=&quot;edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7&quot; data-mark-type=&quot;annotation&quot; data-mark-annotation-type=&quot;inlineComment&quot; data-id=&quot;edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7&quot; data-prosemirror-content-type=&quot;mark&quot; data-prosemirror-mark-name=&quot;annotation&quot;&gt;Made by Cast AI \u2014 a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;About the role&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That&#39;s the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer&#39;s p99 and on our P&amp;amp;L. Your mandate is the inference stack&#39;s optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The problem:&lt;\/strong&gt; the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the &quot;right&quot; serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don&#39;t: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we&#39;re nowhere near done. Prefill\/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stack:&lt;\/strong&gt; Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Requirements&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Nice to haves&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost\/quality\/latency Pareto fronts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve run online A\/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;unrealized throughput lives here, and you&#39;ll own it.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;taking an hour to reach serving.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Quantize without regressing quality. INT8\/INT4, FP8\/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill\/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don&#39;t bottleneck&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;on storage or interconnect.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;experiments.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;What\u2019s in it for you?&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Equity options.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and the router deciding which model answers each request is ours too.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Auto Router&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our promise is one enforcement layer for your AI: budgets, spend attribution, and model routing, applied before a request ever hits a model. The Auto Router makes the call: for every request, which model serves it. Eight open-source models whose input prices span more than 20\u00d7, cached input up to 50\u00d7 cheaper than fresh, frontier providers on customers&#39; own keys, and a coding agent that fires hundreds of requests before its task is done. Frontier-level task success at a fraction of the token cost: that sentence is the product, and it stays true only if the model inside the router keeps getting better. That model is yours.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em data-prosemirror-content-type=&quot;mark&quot; data-prosemirror-mark-name=&quot;em&quot;&gt;&lt;span id=&quot;edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7&quot; data-mark-type=&quot;annotation&quot; data-mark-annotation-type=&quot;inlineComment&quot; data-id=&quot;edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7&quot; data-prosemirror-content-type=&quot;mark&quot; data-prosemirror-mark-name=&quot;annotation&quot;&gt;Made &lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;em data-prosemirror-content-type=&quot;mark&quot; data-prosemirror-mark-name=&quot;em&quot;&gt;&lt;span id=&quot;edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7&quot; data-mark-type=&quot;annotation&quot; data-mark-annotation-type=&quot;inlineComment&quot; data-id=&quot;edb2bdea-40e7-48f0-9485-a0bd7169c7c7&quot; data-prosemirror-content-type=&quot;mark&quot; data-prosemirror-mark-name=&quot;annotation&quot;&gt;by Cast AI \u2014 a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;About the role&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Every request gets a decision: which model serves it.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is an applied-ML seat, not an infrastructure one. Platform engineers own the proxy, the streaming path, and the fleet. You own the model inside them: the training data, the objective, the evaluation, and the iteration loop that ships a better router every cycle.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The problem:&lt;\/strong&gt; routing is a prediction problem wearing a product&#39;s clothes. For every request you predict the quality each candidate model would deliver, what it would cost, and how fast it would decode, and you have to be right enough, in aggregate, that the savings are real and the quality never dips below frontier. The data is messy: rollout outcomes from benchmark harnesses, per-request records from the live fleet, override signals, and token streams whose speed depends on the serving concurrency at the moment. Speed itself is a correctness variable: on deadline-bound agentic work, a model that decodes three times slower doesn&#39;t do the same work slower, it does less work. That&#39;s why naive cost-per-token objectives quietly optimize for the wrong thing. And the bar for evidence is high: a router change ships only after production-parity evaluation with error bars, then gets held to its numbers in live traffic.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stack:&lt;\/strong&gt; Python; PyTorch; SQL at scale (ClickHouse); OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM APIs; benchmark and rollout harnesses (RouterBench-class); GitLab CI.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Requirements&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve spent 5+ years in applied ML or ML research, and you&#39;ve trained, evaluated, and shipped models that make real-time decisions (ranking, recommendation, bandits, pricing, or LLM routing) and you can tell that story with receipts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong Python and SQL at scale: you can pull, clean, and interrogate millions of request-level records without waiting on anyone.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You know the difference between a model that got better and an eval that got easier.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You have real opinions about what LLM benchmarks measure, agentic harnesses included.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You know enough serving reality (TTFT, decode speed, batching, prefix caching, concurrency) to model the objective honestly.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You instrument before you optimize, error bars and all.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Nice to haves&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost\/quality\/latency Pareto fronts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;You&#39;ve run online A\/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the routing model end to end: features, objective, training, calibration, and release cadence. Iterate it like a product, not a research artifact.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Build the evaluation that gates every change: production-parity benchmarks, router-vs-router comparisons, holdouts by task family, error bars on pass rates.&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;Nothing ships on vibes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Turn fleet data into training signal: per-request outcomes from production, benchmark rollouts, and override feedback, with failure categorization (infra vs&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;task) so poisoned labels never reach the policy.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Model the objective the user actually experiences: task success \u00d7 token cost \u00d7 wall-clock speed under the real concurrency regime, with cached-input&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;economics in the picture.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Run the online loop: shadow, A\/B, full rollout, drift monitoring, retrain. When production disagrees with your offline eval, you find out why before the next&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;ship.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Push the frontier where it pays: calibrated decisions, abstention under uncertainty, speed-aware routing. We experiment on what a router should be, not just&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;which model it picks today.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with platform engineers on instrumentation: the features and labels recorded per request (decode speed first-class among them) and the experiments&lt;br&gt;&amp;nbsp;the data path must support.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;What\u2019s in it for you?&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Equity options.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure\u2014not just delivery of a report.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Trust and safety reviews for new features<\/strong>. Establish and run a dedicated T&amp;S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Incident follow-through and continuous improvement<\/strong>. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Learn more about our Trust &amp; Safety infrastructure in our <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https:\/\/helloeverai.zendesk.com\/hc\/en-us\/sections\/57000578321305-Trust-and-Safety\">Trust &amp; Safety Hub<\/a>.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h1>Your Qualifications<\/h1><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Data-driven product decisions that align with legal\/ethical standards:<\/strong> You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers\/dashboards, and strategic planning;<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Content moderation and AI guardrails<\/strong>: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Legal\/safety work experience<\/strong>: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Collaborative mindset and communication<\/strong>: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams \u2014 these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken \u2013 een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in \u00e9\u00e9n dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat \u00e9cht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag \u00e9\u00e9n werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house \u2013 hardware \u00e9n software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https:\/\/www.monumental.co\/our-vision\/\">onze visie<\/a> en <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https:\/\/www.monumental.co\/about\/\">ons bedrijf<\/a>. Misschien vind je ons <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/@buildmonumental\">YouTube-kanaal <\/a>interessant, <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A\">de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken<\/a>, of <a target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer nofollow\" href=\"https:\/\/www.youtube.com\/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns\">deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet.<\/a><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Over de functie<\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die \u2018deployments\u2019. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit.<\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&amp;D-team.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Wat je gaat doen<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren.
